reason: The oxide-scale/self-healing hypothesis is scientifically testable but was not studied in the oxygen-free molecular-dynamics work, which instead varied temperature and attributed wear changes to lattice disorder and dislocations. The key also conflates the 30 Å nanoindentation protocol with the 10 Å friction protocol and oversimplifies inconsistent reported dislocation trends, though this does not materially improve the hypothesis’s reconstruction score.
